Bash(__NEW_LINE__ mysql -h localhost -P 3307 -u root -p000000 health_management -e "
SELECT ''=== 最终数据验证 ==='' as info;

SELECT 
  ''菜单类型统计'' as category,
  CASE 
    WHEN menu_type = 0 THEN ''目录''
    WHEN menu_type = 1 THEN ''菜单/iframe''
    WHEN menu_type = 3 THEN ''按钮''
    ELSE CONCAT(''其他('', menu_type, '')'')
  END as menu_type_name,
  CASE WHEN is_static = 1 THEN ''静态'' ELSE ''动态'' END as source_type,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM menus
WHERE status = 1
GROUP BY menu_type, is_static
ORDER BY is_static DESC, menu_type;

SELECT '''' as empty;
SELECT ''权限标识示例（按钮）'' as category;
SELECT 
  title,
  auths,
  CASE WHEN is_static = 1 THEN ''静态'' ELSE ''动态'' END as source_type
FROM menus
WHERE status = 1 AND menu_type = 3
ORDER BY is_static DESC, id
LIMIT 10;
")
